properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): the root-cause skill's precedent step reaches only what was written into nodes. By accepted design the server never reads a registered file for meaning (req:reflow2-measures-registered-files-and-never-reads-them-for-meaning, dec:agent-navigates-content), so reading the files is the agent's half, and step ② never tells the agent to do it. A hub whose past fixes live in a file archive gets a silent "no precedent"
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-09-28, triaging art:hxm-program-feedback-2026-09-28 (hxm_program hub, 2026-09-28, reflow2 0.73.0) under rule:field-feedback-issues-are-root-caused-and-ideas-are-brainstormed. Item F-31.

① OBSERVED, the reporter's words: "Root-cause step ② (precedent) is blind to the hub's own troubleshooting archive. The skill's precedent bone is `search_design`, BM25 over nodes. The hub's past-issues catalogue (`planning/tasks/*/archive/*.md`) is where every prior beamline fix actually lives, and nothing in reflow2 searches it. I grepped it by hand. The same 'eleven occurrences before anyone searched' failure the skill warns about is structurally guaranteed for anything filed outside the graph." EXPECTED: step ② answers "has this happened before?" wherever the project keeps its past fixes. NOT AFFECTED: precedent that WAS written into the design is found (the skill changed three answers for the same reporter on 2026-09-09→10), and the rest of the skill ran well on a hardware incident the same day.

② PRECEDENT, searched on the raw words ("precedent search troubleshooting archive files outside the graph grepped by hand", "has this happened before prior incident resolution archive lookup", "search registered file contents index document text"): no earlier record of this gap. The governing records came back instead: req:reflow2-measures-registered-files-and-never-reads-them-for-meaning (accepted 2026-09-18: "nothing returns content ... Reading for meaning (parsing, extracting, navigating) stays the agent's") and dec:agent-navigates-content (accepted 2026-07-31: "reflow2 BUILDS NO RETRIEVAL LAYER ... no search into blobs. Reading a 1000-page document and finding the relevant passage is the AGENT's job"). Adjacent: fact:root-cause-a-population-check-has-no-served-form-2026-09-28 (search_design as the only matcher).

③ CANDIDATES, from the bones:
(A) GOVERNANCE, by design: the server never reads file text for meaning, so a file archive can reach search_design only through what somebody wrote into a node.
(B) CONTRACT / INSTRUCTION: the division of labour gives file-reading to the agent, and the skill's precedent step names only search_design, so the agent's half is never asked for.
(C) DISCOVERABILITY, the observation is wrong: a served route already puts file text in the index (registering the archive with link_artifact, or ingest_corpus_step), and the reporter missed it.
(D) NOT IN THE SUSPECTED PART: the precedent is in files because operations records have no cheap home in the design (the report's F-30). The blindness is downstream of where the record was put.

④ WHAT SEPARATES THEM: (C) predicts that a registered file's BODY words are findable by search_design. (A) predicts no served tool returns or indexes file content. (B) predicts the served skill text names no file source for precedent. (D) predicts the archive entries have no node at all in the hub's design; that is the reporter's own statement for the day's incident ("0 design nodes for its asset").

⑤ RESULTS, reflow2-mcp 0.74.0 on a scratch store with a one-file archive (Symptom / Root cause / Resolution / Provenance):
· link_artifact registered the file and measured it (sha256, 265 bytes). search_design on words from its NAME found it. On words only in its BODY ("relay timing power-cycle") it returned 0 hits. topic_report likewise found only the name. Adding a description that restates the symptom made it findable. ⇒ (C) REFUTED as stated: registration indexes the name and description a caller writes, never the file's text.
· ingest_corpus_step: its served description says "YOU walk the directory and read the files — reflow2 performs no file I/O — and hand over `text`". It turns a folder into DESIGN nodes through an extraction interview, not into searchable precedent. It is a route for text the agent hands in, but for another purpose.
· measure.rs head comment: "Bytes in, a number out ... Nothing here returns content." ⇒ (A) HOLDS, and it is accepted intent, not a defect.
· Served skill text (getting-started/skills/root-cause/SKILL.md, lines 63 and 89): step ② is "`search_design` on the raw error text", and the Precedent bone is "`search_design` on the raw error (step ②)". The skill's file mentions are all about CAUSES (the artifact bridge; coverage_report's unmodelled files), never about where precedent lives. ⇒ (B) HOLDS.
· (D) cannot be measured here without the hub's design. The reporter's own counts support it, and it is the subject of the report's F-30 and O-17.

⑥ CLASS: a served skill step's reach is the design's reach, and the design's reach ends at what was written into it. The doctrine that makes the agent the reader of files (dec:agent-navigates-content) never reached the instruction that needs it. Would a fix at the class have stopped the 2026-08 "eleven occurrences" report the skill cites? That one was inside the design, so no. This is a NEW class member: a precedent outside the design, which the skill's own honest-limits line ("It can only offer candidates about what it MODELS") predicts for causes and never says for precedent. COUNT: 20 served skills call search_design as a "has this been written down?" check. The root-cause skill is the one whose purpose makes a file-held precedent decisive.

⑦ OUT OF SCOPE; no code or skill text changed. A test pinning the CLASS would assert that every served skill step claiming to check whether something "is already written down" names every place the project keeps such records that the agent can reach. At minimum that means the design and the project's registered files. Today the root-cause skill fails it.

REPORTER'S CONCLUSIONS. HELD: "the skill's precedent bone is search_design, BM25 over nodes"; "nothing in reflow2 searches it". QUALIFIED: "structurally guaranteed for anything filed outside the graph" holds for the SERVER, by accepted intent; it is not guaranteed for the AGENT, which may read the files and was never told to. The remedy the report proposes (the server searches registered file trees, O-18) would reopen that accepted requirement. It is recorded as an idea with that cost stated: dec:idea-root-cause-precedent-reaches-the-projects-own-file-archive.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: the hub's own archive size and shape (not read); whether the day's incident HAD a precedent in the archive (the report says the agent grepped, not what it found); whether other hubs keep precedent in files at the same rate.
